sloka: गणिकाः तत्र गच्छन्तु रूपवत्यः स्वलंकृताः ।प्रलोभ्य विविध उपायैः आनेष्यन्ति इह सत्कृताः ॥१-१०-५॥
transliteration: gaṇikāḥ tatra gacchantu rūpavatyaḥ svalaṁkṛtāḥ ।pralobhya vividha upāyaiḥ āneṣyanti iha satkṛtāḥ ॥1-10-5॥

translations.english: Beautiful and welladorned courtesans, may be sent there. They will allure him by various means and honourably bring him here.
